...Respondent(S):
 Petition under Article 226 of the Constitution of India praying that in the
circumstances stated in the affidavit filed therewith, the High Court may be
pleased topleased to issue a Writ, Order or direction more particularly one in
the nature of Writ of Mandamus to declaring the action on the part of the
respondents herein not taking any action In respect of the Representation
dated 03-11-2023 before the Superintendent of Police and Station House
Officer/5th Respondent of Nellore District regarding theft and removal of
electricity meters with service connection in respect of the plots Nos. 71, 72,
90, 91 and 89 in Sy.No.83, 89 and watchmans container and transported
through vehicle baring No. Ap 39 Fh 0473 and Ap 26 U 7002 as per the
representation made by the petitioners dated 03-11-2023 and 10-11-2023 as
illegal, arbitrary and violative of articled 14,19 and 21 of the Constitution of
India
Ia No: 1 Of 2024
 Petition under Section 151 Cpc praying that in the circumstances stated
in the affidavit filed in support of the petition, the High Court may be pleased
pleased to direct the respondents to take action as per the representation
dated 03-11-2023 and 10- 11-2023 pending disposal of the above writ petition
and to pass

sentences.text:
2. Heard Sri Singamsetty V.M.Sankar, learned counsel for the petitioners and Sri P.Ajay Babu,
learned Assistant Government Pleader appearing for Home.
3.
Learned counsel for the petitioners would submit that police are not taking any action against the complaints given by the petitioner.

4. Learned Assistant Government Pleader on written instructions would submit that a crime in Cr.No.29 of 2023 for the offences under Sections 447, 420, 506 r/w 34 IPC, on the file of Vedayalapalem Police Station, SPS Nellore District has been registered against the unofficial respondents and no further orders are required to be passed in this matter.
5. Recording the submission of the learned Assistant Government Pleader, this writ petition is disposed of.
